description: Units in which content usage caps are expressed. Used in Quota.metric. A quota expresses a cap that gates license validity, not a billing quantity — billing is in Pricing.

metrics.description: Words of content text rendered to an end user in a response, publication, or display.
metrics.notes: Used to cap how much text from a licensed work may appear in generated outputs. Enables per-word licensing where the publisher controls the maximum excerpt length visible to end users. Does not cover words consumed internally by an AI model (see input-tokens).

metrics.description: Number of times the content is displayed to an end user.
metrics.notes: Standard metric in stock media and advertising licensing. Adobe Stock and Shutterstock cap some licenses at 500,000 impressions. One display of an image or video frame to one user session = one impression. Applies to display function use.

metrics.description: LLM output tokens generated in responses where this content was used as context.
metrics.notes: Measures the downstream output attributable to this content. Distinct from input-tokens (tokens consumed reading the content). Relevant when the publisher wants to cap the total AI-generated output derived from their content, independent of how many times it was accessed.

metrics.description: LLM input tokens consumed from this content across all inference calls.
metrics.notes: Measures the content actually read by the model. Distinct from tokens (output). Relevant when the publisher wants to cap total ingestion of their content by AI systems, e.g., for training-adjacent read-heavy use cases.

metrics.description: Physical units manufactured from or incorporating this design or pattern.
metrics.notes: Use with Pricing.metering = OFFLINE_SELF_REPORTED — the Exchange cannot observe manufacturing events; the agent self-reports and the Exchange audits. Covers 3D-printed items, CNC-machined parts, injection-molded products, and other physical instantiations of licensed CAD/patent/design content.

metrics.description: Number of distinct content access or retrieval events.
metrics.notes: One fetch/read of the content = one access. Suitable for general-purpose quota gates across any function. More granular than impressions (which are user-facing) — an access may not produce a visible impression.

metrics.description: Number of digital or physical copies produced.
metrics.notes: Mechanical reproduction metric used in copyright licensing. Covers digital files distributed, print runs, and audio/video copies. Triggered by reproduce and distribute function use. One distributed file to one recipient = one copy.

metrics.description: Number of distinct named users licensed to access the content.
metrics.notes: Per-seat license model common in enterprise software and dataset licensing. Each distinct human who accesses the content counts as one seat. Requires the Exchange to track user identity across accesses, which may require additional agent identity signals.
